```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
```

```{python}
load_dotenv()

data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
BUFFER_MILES = 50
BUFFER_METERS = BUFFER_MILES * 1609.344

geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes" / "geojson_counties_fips.json"

OVERLAP_TABLE = f"transformed.county_buffer_overlap_{BUFFER_MILES}mi"
OUTPUT_TABLE = f"transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_{BUFFER_MILES}mi"

SQM_PER_SQMI = 2_589_988.110336
```

```{python}
counties_df = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT
        county_id,
        land_area_sqmi,
        water_area_sqmi
    FROM us_counties
""", engine)

dc_df = pd.read_sql("""
    SELECT
        county_id,
        year,
        estabs
    FROM naics_518_establishments
""", engine)
```

```{python}
counties_geo = gpd.read_file(geojson_path)

# Fix for mismatch of old county code 
counties_geo["id"] = counties_geo["id"].replace({"46113": "46102"})

counties_geo = counties_geo[["id", "geometry"]].copy()
counties_geo = counties_geo.rename(columns = {"id": "county_id"})
```

```{python}
counties_final = counties_df.merge(counties_geo, on = "county_id", how = "left")
```

```{python}
counties_final = gpd.GeoDataFrame(counties_final, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4326")

counties_final = counties_final.to_crs(5070) 

counties_final["geometry"] = counties_final.geometry.make_valid()
```

```{python}
counties_final["geom_area_sqmi"] = counties_final.geometry.area / SQM_PER_SQMI

counties_final["total_area_sqmi"] = (
    counties_final["land_area_sqmi"] +
    counties_final["water_area_sqmi"]
)

counties_final["land_share"] = (
    counties_final["land_area_sqmi"] / counties_final["total_area_sqmi"]
)
```

```{python}
buffers = counties_final[["county_id", "geometry"]].copy()
buffers["geometry"] = buffers.geometry.buffer(BUFFER_METERS) 
buffers = buffers.rename(columns={"county_id": "target_county_id"})
```

```{python}
candidate_pairs = gpd.sjoin(
    buffers,
    counties_final[["county_id", "geometry"]],
    how = "inner",
    predicate = "intersects"
)

candidate_pairs = candidate_pairs.rename(columns={"county_id": "neighbor_county_id"})
candidate_pairs = candidate_pairs[
    candidate_pairs["target_county_id"] != candidate_pairs["neighbor_county_id"]
].copy()
candidate_pairs = candidate_pairs[["target_county_id", "neighbor_county_id"]].drop_duplicates()
```

```{python}
buffer_geom = buffers.rename(columns={"geometry": "buffer_geometry"})
neighbor_geom = counties_final[["county_id", "geometry", "land_share", "geom_area_sqmi"]].rename(
    columns={
        "county_id": "neighbor_county_id",
        "geometry": "neighbor_geometry",
        "land_share": "neighbor_land_share",
        "geom_area_sqmi": "neighbor_geom_area_sqmi"
    }
)

overlap = (
    candidate_pairs
    .merge(buffer_geom, on="target_county_id", how="left")
    .merge(neighbor_geom, on="neighbor_county_id", how="left")
)

buffer_series = gpd.GeoSeries(overlap["buffer_geometry"], crs=counties_final.crs)
neighbor_series = gpd.GeoSeries(overlap["neighbor_geometry"], crs=counties_final.crs)

intersection_geom = buffer_series.intersection(neighbor_series, align=False)

overlap = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    overlap,
    geometry=intersection_geom,
    crs=counties_final.crs
)

overlap = overlap[
    overlap.geometry.notna() &
    ~overlap.geometry.is_empty
].copy()

overlap["overlap_area_sqmi"] = overlap.geometry.area / SQM_PER_SQMI
overlap["effective_land_overlap_sqmi"] = (
    overlap["overlap_area_sqmi"] * overlap["neighbor_land_share"]
)

overlap["neighbor_land_area_sqmi"] = overlap["neighbor_geom_area_sqmi"] * overlap["neighbor_land_share"]

overlap_df = overlap[[
    "target_county_id",
    "neighbor_county_id",
    "neighbor_geom_area_sqmi",
    "neighbor_land_share",
    "neighbor_land_area_sqmi",
    "overlap_area_sqmi",
    "effective_land_overlap_sqmi"
]].copy()

overlap_df = overlap_df.rename(columns={"target_county_id": "county_id"})
```
